name: Fediverse Social Link Field
description: Adds Fediverse platforms (Mastodon, Lemmy, Hubzilla, generic Fediverse) to Social Link Field's social link fields.
project_description: Extends the Social Link Field module by adding Fediverse social media platforms as selectable social networks. It ships four SocialLinkFieldPlatform plugins - a generic Fediverse platform plus Mastodon, Lemmy and Hubzilla - so editors can add profile links for these networks to any Social Link Field. It provides only platform definitions (id, label, Font Awesome icon and URL prefix); the field type, widget, formatters and rendering are all supplied by the required Social Link Field parent module. No configuration is required.
